text:
Maya (PM): Quick async qtr check — please mark each item as "shipped" / "slipped + ETA" / "blocked w/ owner". I'll list owners next to items. Need final statuses by EOD.

Maya (PM): 1) Runtime v3 SLOs + canary routing — owner: Sanjay
Maya (PM): 2) Dedicated capacity autoscale configs — owner: Lia
Maya (PM): 3) Console per-route latency dashboards — owner: Kev
Maya (PM): 4) Eval suite for regressions + alerts — owner: Ash

Sanjay (Eng): runtime v3 — canary is live at 10% in us-west; latency p50 improved ~12% but seeing occasional ~200ms tail bump. Not fully shipped. ETA for rollout: ~2 weeks if infra quota approved. Blocked: need +2 GPU quota from infra. @Lia can you confirm infra ETA? :eyes:

Lia (Eng): autoscale configs — core rules merged (PR #423) but autoscaler tests flaked in staging. Slipping ~4d. I can dig in on the flake tomorrow. Quota request filed (INC-4321) — tentative approval by Fri per ticket update. Will escalate if it shifts.

Kev (Eng): dashboard work — shipped base per-route latency panels + tracing hooks. Remaining: cost-breakdown card + docs. Docs CR pending review (PR #438). Pinged for reviews, need 1 more reviewer.

Ash (DS): eval suite — ran evals on 12 prompt sets; two regressions vs baseline on summary quality. Marking as slipped for now. Working with Sanjay on a targeted prompt set to triage. ETA ~5 business days for root cause and a roll-forward plan.

Sanjay (Eng): note on infra quota — if approval delayed we can reduce canary traffic and slow rollout. Also spotted a quantization profile that correlates with tail bump; will try fallback profile.

Kev (Eng): CR ping — @Lia @Sanjay can you review the docs PR today? small changes, ~15m.

Lia (Eng): ack, will review after stand. If quota looks stuck I can escalate.

Maya (PM): quick unblock ask — Sanjay, if quota delayed what is minimal safe canary to avoid tail spikes?

Sanjay (Eng): minimal safe = 5% with reduced beam size and KV prefix caching on. Config suggestion below:
```yaml
canary:
  traffic_pct: 5
  beam_size: 1
  kv_cache: true
  fallback: runtime-v2
```
That should contain anomalies while we scale.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime-v3-canary -> 1747003000 (traffic 10%) :rocket:

Ash (DS): I'll run targeted evals against canary traffic and post results by EOD.

Maya (PM): Action items: Sanjay -> finalize canary plan + confirm minimal-safe config; Lia -> finish autoscaler flake fix + confirm quota ETA; Kev -> get docs CR merged; Ash -> triage eval regressions and share examples. Reply with 'ack' or ETA. Thanks :thumbsup:

Sanjay (Eng): ack — ETA full rollout 2 weeks if quota OK, otherwise will propose 3-step phased plan by EOD.

Lia (Eng): ack — testing tomorrow, quota tentatively Fri.

Kev (Eng): ack — will merge docs by EOD after CRs.

Ash (DS): ack — reporting regressions + triage notes by EOD.
